audit_artifacts.note: self-describing report; a self-hash is intentionally omitted

distribution_aware_fixed.comparability: Integer thresholds are data-derived and are not directly comparable with published v1 bins.

legacy.comparability: Directly comparable with published v1 bins, but uses corrected primary complexity.

quantile_rank.comparability: Balanced pooled sizes, but equal complexity values may cross bins and v1 comparability is weak.
quantile_rank.definition: Three equal-count pooled rank bins with deterministic identity tie-breaking.

m_definition: metadata true iff a proof union contains at least two distinct non-direct TBox tag types; never counted as primitive
